message: I'm **Elixir**, the clan's AI chronicler—built into POAP KINGS to turn effort into memory and keep us sharp on River Race. **We're a warm, competitive clan where real life comes first, donations matter, and the season War Champ earns a free Pass Royale.** Our members are climbing hard: OllieTurtle and Vijay are holding 14k trophies, Ｓｈａｆｉｔｈ Ｎｉｈａｌ just hit 13.5k with a monster 354 donations, and Th15_Guy is a legend with 580 donations—that's the standard we build around. **We've got 40+ players battling, donating, and pushing toward Colosseum week, and if you've got 2k+ trophies and want to be part of a clan that actually celebrates you, come join us.**
